children: Thailand's government plans to sell 1.28 trillion baht ($38.46 billion) of government bonds in the 2027 fiscal year beginning on October 1, little changed from 1.277 trillion baht in the current fiscal year, according to a finance ministry source and a market source.
The planned bond issuance is part of an overall funding need of about 2.5 trillion baht for fiscal 2027, down slightly from fiscal 2026, said a source at the ministry's public debt management office.
The sources declined to be identified because the information was not public.
